skill.summary: 提供本地高速、高质量文本转语音服务，支持语音克隆与自动路径管理，无需云端确保隐私安全。

latestVersion.changelog:
LuxTTS skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Integrates high-quality, local LuxTTS text-to-speech into OpenClaw.
- Supports ultra-fast voice generation (up to 150x real-time) and 48kHz audio quality.
- Adds voice cloning and custom voice management features.
- Provides detailed installation, configuration, and troubleshooting guidance.
- Includes tools for batch processing, GPU acceleration, caching, and hybrid TTS fallback.
